name: GROWTH1-1-the-row-cap-moves
note: The cap the docs state and the cap the suite holds would part.

name: GROWTH1-2-the-entry-cap-moves
note: The cap the marker states and the cap the suite holds would part.

name: GROWTH1-3-the-page-cap-moves
note: A dated page could double before anything said so.

name: GROWTH1-4-a-row-at-the-cap-is-past-it
note: A row of exactly ROW_MAX characters would fail the suite.

name: GROWTH1-5-a-frozen-row-may-grow
note: A row already long could keep growing for ever - the very rot GROWTH1 stops.

name: GROWTH1-6-a-frozen-row-is-held-to-the-cap
note: Every one of the 1,191 frozen rows would fail the suite on the day.

name: GROWTH1-7-the-record-never-lets-go-of-a-row
note: A row rewritten within its cap, or deleted, would stay frozen in the record - a record that lies.

name: GROWTH1-8-at-the-cap-is-still-frozen
note: A row brought down to exactly the cap would stay in the record.

name: GROWTH1-9-a-gone-row-stays-frozen
note: A deleted test file's row would stay frozen in the record.

name: GROWTH1-10-a-lost-marker-is-silent
note: Deleting the marker would switch the Active-Arcs rule off - or throw.

name: GROWTH1-11-an-entry-at-the-cap-is-past-it
note: An entry of exactly ENTRY_MAX characters would fail the suite.

name: GROWTH1-12-new-entries-unchecked
note: A new Active-Arcs entry could be an essay again.

name: GROWTH1-13-the-old-entries-may-grow
note: An old entry could be added to, a character at a time.

name: GROWTH1-14-a-page-at-the-cap-is-past-it
note: A dated page of exactly PAGE_MAX bytes would fail the suite.

name: GROWTH1-15-a-frozen-page-may-grow
note: A frozen page could take part after part again.

name: GROWTH1-16-the-record-never-lets-go-of-a-page
note: A page trimmed within its cap would stay frozen in the record.

name: GROWTH1-17-the-audit-log-is-a-dated-page
note: The index of audits (98 KB) would be held to a dated page's cap.

name: GROWTH1-18-a-bare-bug-list-is-no-dated-page
note: Mac-Bugs.md and Janome-Bugs.md would grow unchecked.

name: GROWTH1-19-write-raises-the-record
note: --write would freeze a grown row at its new length - the ratchet turned backwards.

name: GROWTH1-20-write-keeps-what-it-should-let-go
note: --write would keep rows within their cap, and gone ones, frozen.

name: GROWTH1-21-write-raises-the-old-block
note: --write would freeze the old entries at whatever they had grown to.

name: GROWTH1-22-the-record-unsorted
note: The record would be rewritten in whatever order the bible was read - a diff of noise.

name: GROWTH1-23-a-row-measured-with-its-count
note: A test added to a file would grow its row - the count is not prose.

name: GROWTH1-24-the-marker-s-own-line-counted
old: return { above: lines.slice(0, at).filter((l) => l.startsWith('- ')), below: lines.slice(at + 1).join('\n').length };
new: return { above: lines.slice(0, at).filter((l) => l.startsWith('- ')), below: lines.slice(at).join('\n').length };
note: Rewording the marker would read as the old entries growing.

name: GROWTH1-25-the-check-passes-anything
note: The command would say nothing failed - the check a person runs before a push.
